name: Green River (Flaming Geyser)
blurb: Short, easy summer float out of Flaming Geyser State Park below the gorge.

sections.notes: Short, but an AW trip report took ~3 hr with a regular portage around a strainer about halfway. Scout for wood. Flaming Geyser State Park requires a Discover Pass. No fee or hours found for King County's Whitney Bridge Park.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
